    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    channel_id TEXT,
    channel_title TEXT,
    access_token_enc TEXT,
    refresh_token_enc TEXT,
    token_expires_at TEXT,
    scopes TEXT,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'connected',
    connected_at TEXT,
    updated_at TEXT
  )

youtube_oauth_states.name: youtube_oauth_states
youtube_oauth_states.createSql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_oauth_states (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    state_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    code_verifier_enc TEXT NOT NULL,
    redirect_to TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    used_at TEXT,
    created_date TEXT
  )

youtube_uploads.name: youtube_uploads
youtube_uploads.createSql:
CREATE TABLE youtube_uploads (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    output_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
    youtube_video_id TEXT,
    privacy TEXT DEFAULT 'private',
    error_message TEXT
  , project_id TEXT, account_id TEXT, title TEXT, description TEXT, tags TEXT, category_id TEXT, progress INTEGER DEFAULT 0, youtube_url TEXT, processing_status TEXT, error_code TEXT, attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0, next_retry_at TEXT, lease_expires_at TEXT, claimed_at TEXT, upload_session_uri TEXT, bytes_sent INTEGER DEFAULT 0, processing_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0, cancelled_at TEXT, created_date TEXT, updated_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT)
